title: Wild Animals
text:
Lions are wild animals. They live in Africa. They live in groups called prides. A lion has a big head and a long tail. Lions sleep for many hours each day.

Elephants are also wild animals. They are the biggest animals on land. An elephant can eat about 150 kilograms of food each day. Elephants use their long trunks to drink water and to pick up food.

questions.text: What do elephants use their long trunks for?
options: To drink water and pick up food

questions.text: The passage says elephants are the biggest animals on land. What can we guess about an elephant next to a lion?
options: They are exactly the same size
The lion is in the water

questions.text: An elephant can eat about 150 kilograms of food each day. What can we guess from this?
options: Elephants eat a lot of food
Elephants do not eat at all
Elephants eat only once a year

vocabulary.definition: a number of animals or people together
living in nature and not kept by people

paragraph_translations: Los leones son animales salvajes. Viven en África. Viven en grupos llamados manadas. Un león tiene una cabeza grande y una cola larga. Los leones duermen muchas horas cada día.

Los elefantes también son animales salvajes. Son los animales más grandes de la tierra. Un elefante puede comer unos 150 kilos de comida cada día. Los elefantes usan sus trompas largas para beber agua y para recoger comida.
